metrics.conclusion: damped runs are speed-limited at |v| ~ 1.52 c; crossing is delayed by ~ (particle spacing)/c and moves earlier as N grows (monotone at c = 0.01); in the physical regime c >= v_ff the maximal delay is 0.03 time units (2 of 30 runs show no crossing within t = 8, all at c < v_ff)

results.name: lambda * F_P is dimensionless and equals 1

results.name: Xi = c^4/(8 pi G) has the dimension of a force (kg m s^-2)
